The `date` command printed `Sat Oct 3 05:11:28 PM EDT 2026`. That means the server reported Saturday, October 3, 2026, at 5:11:28 PM. EDT is Eastern Daylight Time, which is four hours behind UTC.

Server clocks drift because their hardware oscillators do not keep time perfectly. Temperature changes, aging components, and virtualization can affect their accuracy. Time synchronization services such as NTP periodically correct that drift using reference clocks.
